name: multivibe-host
description: Run the security-bounded MultiVibe provider Host on your own supported NVIDIA GPU. Credentials and device identity are generated inside persistent appdata; the provider agent and managed Ollama stay loopback-only inside the container. Sharing and automatic downloads remain disabled until you explicitly configure the local capacity policy.

paths.name: Application data
paths.description: Persistent private credentials, device identity, policy, database and logs.

paths.name: Model storage
paths.description: Persistent managed runtime and model weights. Use /models/weights when creating the local capacity policy.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Host port for the protected MultiVibe dashboard and API.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Required: enter your actual origin, for example http://192.168.1.10:1455. Match the Web UI host port; do not use or [PORT] placeholders. No path or trailing slash. Use the reverse-proxy HTTPS origin when applicable.

variables.name: NVIDIA GPU
variables.description: GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin, or all. Exposing one supported GPU is recommended; it is index 0 inside the container.

variables.name: NVIDIA capabilities
variables.description: Required CUDA compute and nvidia-smi capabilities.

variables.name: Managed runtime directory
variables.description: Container path for the verified managed Ollama runtime. Model weights are selected separately in the local capacity policy.

variables.name: Container CUDA device
variables.description: Zero-based GPU index inside the container. Keep 0 when a single GPU UUID is exposed.
